topic: Principle of operation of various engine instruments, viz, torque meter, thrust meter, oil pressure gauges, fuel flow meter, jet pipe temper
syllabus_extract: Principle of operation of various engine instruments, viz, torque meter, thrust meter, oil pressure gauges, fuel flow meter, jet pipe temperature indicator, throttle lever, Position indicator, tachometer etc. Introduction to concept of glass cockpit
specific_objectives: 25.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to know and understand the constructional details of starters, ignition units and principles of. operation of various engine instruments

practical: Review of instrument panel layout and identification of engine instruments; Instructor supervision required for safety
intro_questions: What are the primary instruments located on the engine instrument panel?
Define the function of a tachometer in engine operation.
List three safety devices associated with the electrical system.
